hypothesis: The official cumulative pitcher count and success rate exactly encode the current-season successes before each row. A deterministic empirical-Bayes update should adapt to within-season league and pitcher drift more directly than asking a historical CatBoost model to infer the update from raw features.

state_reconstruction.n_current: asof_pitcher_n minus the pitcher count frozen at the end of the preceding season
state_reconstruction.s_current: round(asof_pitcher_success_rate * asof_pitcher_n) minus the pitcher successes frozen at the end of the preceding season
state_reconstruction.unseen_pitcher: preseason n and s are zero
state_reconstruction.invalid_row: zero current evidence and retain the parent

routing.F: the same selected formula with fixed k=20 to retain rapid response to a possible measurement-regime change
routing.reason_for_fixed_F_k: F had a documented 2023 label-regime break, so selecting a slow F update on stable 2020/2021 F labels would answer the wrong question

ranking: maximum minimum R score gain across 2020 and 2021
source_selection.on_fail: close without reading or generating a 2022+ candidate
source_selection.on_pass: freeze formula and k before a fresh 2022/2023 development evaluation
